title: Hi, let me tell you a story about Thabang
excerpt: My career in code didn't start with a sleek Mac and a Silicon Valley dream. It started in 2015, sitting at a desk with Visual Basic .Net and VBA for Excel, figuring out how to make data move.
content:
My career in code didn't start with a sleek Mac and a Silicon Valley dream. It started in 2015, sitting at a desk with Visual Basic .Net and VBA for Excel, figuring out how to make data move. It was humble, it was technical, and it was the foundation for everything that followed.

But the real transformation—the moment my "why" took shape—happened in 2017 when I started attending College.

### 🏛️ Mentorship at Bara Hospital
I landed an internship at Chris Hani Baragwanath Academic Hospital (CHBAH). There, I was taken under the wing of the late Mr. A. Maboko (AD ICT System). He didn't just teach me syntax; he gave me a seat at the table. He included me in the planning and execution of systems that actually impacted human lives in one of the world's largest hospitals.

When he passed, I lost a mentor, but I gained a mission. I carried that work forward with a sense of duty that still drives me today.

### 🏆 Innovation that Scale
That resilient drive led me to the Gauteng Department of Health's Quality Assurance Chief Directorate under the leadership of Ms. Mazibuko (Former DD, Customer Care). This exposure allowed me to observe a massive gap in how we tracked patient experience, so I built a solution to aid our insight: the "Patient Experience of Care Survey" software.

At the time, the department was struggling with manual processes that were largely ineffective, and a national digital system was simply not available. In 2018, I was honored with the Premiers Service Excellence Award (Gold) for building a system that filled that void and surpassed national standards.

### ⏭️ The Current Frontier: Adaptivconcept FL
I started as an intern, then worked as an admin clerk. Today, I am a Senior Systems Developer and Founder of Adaptivconcept FL brand.

Right now, I'm deep in the trenches of some high-impact projects that I am eager to share with you properly, some of which are:
- Onefit™: A wellness ecosystem designed to bridge the gap between trainers and trainees.
- BufferZone EMS: Hardening the admin and logic for event medical services.
- HNS Housing: Reimagining housing management systems.
- Youth Lantern: Building the entrepreneurship hub the next generation needs.

I will be sharing dedicated updates and deep dives on each of these in the coming weeks to put these efforts out there are start connecting more and better and identify opportunities for you and me.

The journey from VBA to AI-Engineering wasn't a straight line, but every step was earned.

Stay tuned for tomorrow's post, where I'll be "Pushing" these lessons into the future.

#CareerJourney #TechImpact #PublicSectorInnovation #AdaptivconceptFL #SeniorDeveloper #SystemsArchitect

title: Finding my Vibe: Pushing the Rise of the AI-Engineer
excerpt: In the world of development, "seniority" isn't just about the years on your CV—it's about the weight of the systems you've carried.
content:
In the world of development, "seniority" isn't just about the years on your CV—it's about the weight of the systems you've carried.

My journey started in 2015 with VB.Net and VBA, but it was forged in the high-stakes environment of the Gauteng Department of Health. Mentored by the late Mr. A. Maboko (AD ICT Systems) and honoured Ms. Patricia Mazibuko (Former DD, Customer Care), I learned early on that technology is a valuable tool for public service.

### 🏆 Substance Proven by Accolades
In 2018, I was honored with the Premiers Service Excellence Award (Gold) for building the "Patient Experience of Care Survey" software. At the time, this level of digitized patient feedback wasn't yet available at a national level. I didn't just write code; I designed a system that became a benchmark for public sector innovation.

Receiving two Public Service Awards (2017, 2018) and being featured in The Sowetan taught me one thing: Accolades come from solving the hardest problems correctly.

### 🏗️ Expertise Showcase: Adaptivconcept FL
Today, I am applying that same senior-level discipline to the Adaptivconcept FL ecosystem. My current portfolio demonstrates the multidisciplinary breadth required to move from concept to enterprise-ready system:
- Back-end Integrity: Using Vanilla PHP and the Laravel Framework to scale clinical management and data administration tools where "vibe" isn't an option and reliability is everything.
- Frontend & 3D Visualization: Leveraging React and Three.js to build modern architectures like the 3D body-mapping and health visualization tools in onefit-3d-studio.
- Data & Automation: Utilizing Python for high-fidelity data analysis and the creation of custom automation scripts that harden system workflows.

### 🛡️ Finding the Vibe: Pushing as an AI-Engineer
We are in a new era. But while the industry is currently infatuated with "Vibe Coding," I am doubling down on Systems Design.

I am an AI-Engineer because I use AI to augment my senior-level workflows, not to replace my judgment. By leveraging Autonomous Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and integrated Documentation, I can push code with higher precision and fewer blind spots.

To me, AI is a force multiplier for Automation Scripts and deterministic architecture. I'm not just pushing code—I'm pushing the boundaries of what a single Senior Developer can achieve when the tools are handled with discipline.

### 🤝 The Next Big Challenge
I am a Senior Developer. I have the accolades to prove my substance and the current projects to showcase my expertise. I am now seeking new and better opportunities to architect high-impact systems at scale.

If you are looking for a veteran who bridges the gap between public-sector accountability and cutting-edge AI-Engineering—let's connect.

Thabang Mposula
Senior Systems Developer | AI-Engineer
Founder, Adaptivconcept FL

Send me an email: thabang.mposula@outlook.com
